packages.summary: Rigid mesh clusters, static scenery HLOD, CPU occlusion and offline baked surface proxies
packages.notes: Use geometry_catalog/analyze before setting explicit policies. Ordinary instancing remains for crowds. HLOD is static scenery only, not gameplay or fog visibility. Verify real cameras and hardware; no virtual geometry streaming or GPU Hi-Z.

packages.summary: Fixed arithmetic, vectors and trigonometry
packages.notes: Use existing Fixed; angles in turns. Check zero vectors and overflow.

packages.summary: FIFO queue and stable top-K
packages.notes: Store queue under NativeState. top ties preserve input order; sort entity inputs by index.

packages.summary: BFS and topological ordering
packages.notes: Use dense IDs. Test unreachable nodes, cycles and duplicate edges. Weighted search and flows remain planned.

packages.summary: Existing game spatial queries
packages.notes: Read current game query API; batch queries. Never infer visibility from presentation. New spatial index adapter remains planned.

packages.summary: Four-neighbor multi-source distance fields
packages.notes: Use row-major IDs. Zero cells are blocked. Bound work and cache under NativeState. Test borders and unreachable cells.

packages.summary: Existing pathfinding and flow fields
packages.notes: Reuse movement commands; do not move entities from view scripts. Test blocked goals, arrival and planets separately.

packages.summary: FSM transitions and utility selection
packages.notes: Persist current state explicitly. Definitions are immutable. Utility ties choose smaller ID. BT/GOAP remain planned.

packages.summary: Priority task claiming and worker release
packages.notes: Use unique task IDs and numeric priority. Set status pending initially. Release dead workers; validate ownership before finishing. Dependencies remain planned.

packages.summary: Atomic integer recipe consumption
packages.notes: Use resource indices and nonnegative integer amounts. Duplicate ingredients are summed. This operates on caller stock, not engine resources; never create a competing economy.

packages.summary: Ordered all/any predicates
packages.notes: Keep functions in immutable definitions, never persistent NativeState. Empty all is true; empty any false. Formula parser remains planned.

packages.summary: Weighted selection and level thresholds
packages.notes: Supply simulation RNG as draw(total), integer 1..total. Zero total returns nullopt. Test zero weights and endpoints. Pity systems remain planned.

packages.summary: Event counters and one-shot completion
packages.notes: Use unique goal IDs and positive integer targets. Save progress. Emit completion only on threshold crossing. Branching dialogue remains planned.

packages.summary: Existing deterministic map generator
packages.notes: Reuse generation presets and engine seeds. Validate fair starts and connectivity. New Poisson/WFC adapters remain planned.

packages.summary: Smoothstep, lerp and timeline progress
packages.notes: Use presentation C++ only. Zero duration completes at start. Read sim events and never write simulation NativeState.

packages.summary: Existing UI templates
packages.notes: Reuse RmlUi templates and localization. Send commands through documented bindings. Virtualized list package remains planned.

packages.summary: Existing snapshot restoration verification
packages.notes: Run tests and sample matches for sim changes. Restore verification does not prove cross-platform determinism. Profile separately from verification.

packages.summary: Context and priority input routing, axis deadzones, selection, control groups and drag gestures
packages.notes: Use normalized platform input. Resolve UI/modal context before game context; send resulting gameplay actions as commands. Store selection/control groups in local presentation state.

packages.summary: RTS/follow/orbit target controls, limits, smoothing and strategic icon threshold
packages.notes: Use delta time only in presentation. Apply resulting Pose to the existing client/editor camera. World-to-sphere mapping remains the planet camera responsibility.

packages.summary: Placement checks, resource explanations, refunds and native construction commands
packages.notes: Call checkPlacement with authoritative map/territory/slope queries. Render its Decision as preview, then submit buildCommand. The engine must revalidate the command at execution time; previews never reserve or debit resources.

packages.summary: Target/range/resource checks and optional native cast/cooldown lifecycle
packages.notes: For built-in abilities send abilityCommand and use engine cooldown/effects. Use AbilityState only for custom native mechanics, and persist all fields. Charge custom resource costs transactionally only after validation.

packages.summary: Stacked inventory, weight/slot limits, atomic transfer, equipment and crafting
packages.notes: Prefer built-in engine item mechanics for existing item types. For custom native inventories validate item definitions, provide stable IDs, serialize each stack/equipment field, and require ownership checks in commands.

packages.summary: Leader election, role ordering, formation slots and native group commands
packages.notes: Use formationCommand for engine formations; use formationSlots for custom planning only. Sort/tie-break by entity ID. Feed desired slots to navigation rather than teleporting units.

packages.summary: Event-to-sound/particle/animation/notification/camera actions with cooldowns
packages.notes: Bind dispatch callbacks to existing presentation services. Use only accepted sim events; clear FeedbackState after rollback/seek and never feed it into gameplay logic.

packages.summary: Event-driven tutorial stages, counters, branches, skip and hard/soft action gating
packages.notes: Validate immutable steps at load. Persist step/progress/complete in NativeState. Hard gating must also validate commands, not only hide UI. Highlight is a host UI target ID, not a renderer.

packages.summary: Transactional versioned state migrations plus checksummed JSON backup tools
packages.notes: Migrate on import/load before installing state. Engine nativeModules VERSION compatibility is distinct: this API cannot force an incompatible engine save to load. Use gameplay.py save/restore for JSON envelopes only.

packages.summary: Structured refusal codes, values and bounded decision traces
packages.notes: Use reasonKey with Localization::tr; pass subject/required/available as parameters. Traces are diagnostic outputs only; never depend on trace capacity for simulation outcomes.

packages.summary: Content budgets, PNG dimensions, localization consistency and existing conversion tool orchestration
packages.notes: Run audit, then pipeline with explicit modelconv/audiopack paths. Conversion capability depends on the engine tool build. Source licensing is still the project author responsibility.

packages.summary: Headless seed checks, snapshot/serialized restore gates and machine-readable reports
packages.notes: Run verify against the built project-specific headless executable. Set requireWinner for combat scenarios; tutorial/sandbox scenarios may intentionally have no winner. A successful headless run does not validate UI rendering.

packages.summary: Plan and validated application of resource/building/ability/faction changes
packages.notes: Generate a plan, inspect checks, then apply with the real project-specific headless executable. Apply validates a staged copy before replacing rules.json and retains a content-addressed backup. Never overwrite a stale plan.

packages.summary: Generated C++ settings, JSON Schema, defaults and strict config parsing
packages.notes: Edit libraries/spec/gameplay.json and regenerate. C++ loader and CLI reject unknown fields, wrong types and cross-field violations. Do not edit generated files by hand.

packages.summary: Snapshot UI bindings, escaped values and bounded action queues
packages.notes: Use BindingModel.set/drain on a read-only snapshot. Invalidate after document reload or language change. Dispatch Actions through host Command routing. Do not retain simulation references.

packages.summary: Configurable screen rows, modal routing and RmlUi binding
packages.notes: Use Screen/ScreenStack and the RmlScreenBinding adapter. Supply rows for HUD, building, units, inventory, technology, pause and results. Destroy bindings before document roots. Revalidate action ownership and affordability in the sim. Rendering needs host integration and screenshot QA.

packages.summary: Safe-area layouts, density clamp and validated theme tokens
packages.notes: Use layout with framebuffer or dp units consistently; never mix them. Apply safe insets from the platform. themeStyles emits RmlUi RCSS dp units. Resolve translations before markup. Test portrait/landscape and large text.

packages.summary: Authoritative match result to idempotent meta transaction
packages.notes: Use grantMatch with aiverse::meta::Economy after authoritative completion. Link aiverse::meta and provide durable Commit CAS. Keep a stable unique match id across retries. Never call from predicted finishes, replay seeks or sim ticks. Nullopt is invalid envelope; inspect meta Result for conflict/denial.

packages.summary: Application state transitions and stale loading completion rejection
packages.notes: Use Lifecycle.send for explicit events. Capture generation before async load and call loaded(ticket). Host owns cancellation and resource cleanup. Pausing local UI must not stop a shared multiplayer simulation.

packages.summary: Transport-independent lobby, reconnect and ordered delivery policy
packages.notes: Provide transport/authentication outside this package. Use epoch on each async callback; retain sequence across reconnect and reset on a new session. Content hashes must come from verified manifests. accept is for ordered message streams, not out-of-order UDP or multiple peer channels. Do not present this as a server or netcode implementation.

packages.summary: Versioned dependency resolution, conflicts and deterministic mod order
packages.notes: Build ContentPackage records from trusted manifests, then resolveContent. Digest is required metadata, not computed or verified here; verify actual bytes through catalog pins/content tooling before mounting. Mount in returned order with explicit override rules. Never execute untrusted scripts or use manifest paths without validation.

packages.summary: Mirrored round-robin cases and aggregate faction outcomes
packages.notes: Use roundRobin with identical seed lists and swapped starts. Record actual player-to-faction mapping. Use addSample only for completed matches/draws; keep time limits separate. Run playlab.py against prepared project variations; report sample counts and seeds, not unsupported confidence claims.

packages.summary: Tick-indexed actions and assertions for automated play
packages.notes: Validate Scenario once before running. Advance at every exact tick; emit normal Commands via callback and supply authoritative metric snapshots. Missing metrics and skipped ticks fail. Reset the runner for each run; do not reuse it after rollback without restoring cursor state.

packages.summary: Nearest-rank p95, peak limits and baseline regression checks
packages.notes: Collect timing outside sim after warm-up on the same hardware/build/quality. Samples and budgets must share units. Use summarize and checkBudget; insufficient samples fail. Never let timing metrics affect deterministic gameplay. Report peak and sample count as well as p95.

packages.summary: Reusable capability and acceptance recipes for four genres
packages.notes: Use genreKit to select existing library packages and acceptance scenarios. Configure engine rules and templates before adding code. Kits are composition recipes, not complete generated games. Implement the named acceptance scenarios for the actual project and verify them.

packages.summary: Dependency-ordered change recipes and verification checklist
packages.notes: Describe explicit ChangeRecipe dependencies/files/checks and call planChanges. Unknown IDs and cycles fail. Review actual file diffs; the planner does not infer semantics or edit files. Apply supported rule mutations with existing gameplay.py recipe/apply and its stale-base checks.

packages.summary: Generate a registered external native C++ module
packages.notes: Generate into a new directory from a reviewed schema. Never overwrite custom module handlers; review the generated diff. Merge rules.fragment.json into nativeModules explicitly. Run the generated Smoke.cpp and external-native tests. Module.cpp intentionally has no game-specific effects.

packages.summary: Generate typed NativeState access and transactional migrations
packages.notes: Declare bounded int64 and bool fields. Use initialize only for empty setup state; load validates schema/ranges, store validates atomically. Define explicit rename/set/erase migration steps. Migration does not bypass engine nativeModules VERSION compatibility. Keep engine simulation state in NativeState.

packages.summary: Generate typed native Command encoders and dispatch
packages.notes: Reserve a project-unique commandType in 32768..65535 and unique action IDs. Use encode then Simulation.submit. decode checks type, action, nonneutral player, exact argument count and bounds. Handlers must separately validate player range, ownership, resources and target lifetimes. Commands do not grant authority.

packages.summary: Validate ID, file and localization/content references
packages.notes: Supply explicit source/target selectors. Use /@keys for dictionaries and /* for arrays/objects. Configure required matches for mandatory categories; optional zero matches are allowed. Use the shipped rules preset, then add schema-specific ability/audio/localization selectors. Run the real engine validator too; this is not a full rules parser.

packages.summary: Stage and atomically activate validated host settings
packages.notes: Stage with parser returning optional settings and a validator. Commit only at a safe point using expected revision. Failed staging clears pending data and preserves live settings. Handle parser exceptions in the host. Never hot-reload deterministic gameplay state using a filesystem clock; replicate gameplay changes through Commands.

packages.summary: Fixed-capacity scratch buffers and generational slot pools
packages.notes: Choose capacity from a documented budget; handle full buffers/pools explicitly. Stale or released handles fail. Slot indices are allocated in deterministic order. Capacity bounds objects, not heap memory inside T. Use fixed-size element types in hot paths. Persist pool/handle state through NativeState if it affects outcomes.

packages.summary: Deterministic round-robin work with operation budgets
packages.notes: Keep WorkItems sorted by unique ID. Each callback performs one bounded operation without modifying the items span or cursor. Persist completed counters and WorkCursor for rollback. Failed callback must leave its own output untouched. Never budget by elapsed wall time or use unordered iteration.

packages.summary: Locate the first differing native field and trace tick
packages.notes: Use firstStateDifference for NativeState-compatible maps and arrays. Export canonical tick/modules snapshots from both runs, then use project_checks.py desync. Missing or differently sampled ticks are coverage errors. Only exported fields can be diagnosed; this does not automatically instrument every ECS pool.

packages.summary: Read-only package upgrade plan from lock hashes
packages.notes: Compare schema-2 libraries.lock.json with the current catalog/engine root. Review version changes, changed transitive files and required checks. The tool never updates pins or migrates code automatically. Run project tests and update pins only as an explicit reviewed project change.

packages.summary: End-to-end real RTS simulation, RmlUi, save and meta reward example
packages.notes: Create isolated content with showcase_project.py. Build the opt-in aiverse_library_showcase target and run --auto with a fresh output directory. Check actual build/attack events, save checksum round trip, idempotent meta rewards and screenshot. Reward storage is a single-process example, not a production backend. Use distinct match IDs for distinct authoritative matches.

packages.summary: Authoritative effective stat snapshots through existing modifiers
packages.notes: Call effectiveStats after checking the entity. Configure existing StatMod/tech/level/status rules; never evaluate a parallel modifier stack. The snapshot returns final values, not an invented per-source breakdown. Missing units and invalid stats fail.

packages.summary: Status snapshots and validated entry to the existing status engine
packages.notes: Use statuses for copies of active stacks/expiry/source data. applyStatus is a simulation-only hook after authority checks, outside ECS iteration. True means valid invocation, not proof a status bypassed immunity. Engine statuses own refresh, stacks, periods, flags and hashing.

packages.summary: All/any/none tag filters and bounded-value conditions
packages.notes: Resolve type tags using Rules.tagMask; reject unknown names with resolveTags. Keep type tags separate from status/dispel tags. Missing condition inputs fail closed. Built-in EffectDef target filters remain authoritative.

packages.summary: Stable action previews plus native built-in interaction commands
packages.notes: Use interactions for sorted preview options and disabled reasons. Build actual Smart/PickItem/UseItem/Load/ToggleLock Commands with EngineMechanics.interactionCommand, then submit through Simulation. For ToggleLock actor is the selected gate; PickItem uses point. Custom actions use generated native commands and revalidate at execution.

packages.summary: Transactional reservation, release and consumption of custom capacities
packages.notes: Use ticket and owner IDs > 0. Repeating an identical live reservation is Duplicate; conflicting payload/owner fails. Commit validates aggregate capacity before changing stock; release does not consume. Keep built-in Inventory.reserved under its existing owner. Persist tickets with Persistence.h; handle cancellation and owner destruction.

packages.summary: Tick-based multi-stage actions with timeout and cancellation cleanup
packages.notes: Advance once per increasing tick. begin false must have no side effects; poll is read-only; cleanup is called once for each entered stage on completion/cancel/failure. One stage transition per call bounds work. Implement navigation through existing commands; persist sequence state. Couple reservations to stage cleanup.

packages.summary: Weighted loot with exclusions and a guaranteed rare threshold
packages.notes: Reuse weighted selection through rollLoot. Draw must return an integer in [1,total]; use rollSimLoot to consume sim.rng with a validated uint32 total. Guarantee N forces eligible rare loot on attempt N after N-1 misses. Impossible guarantees fail without drawing. Persist pity state and validate/exclude before sampling; reward granting remains separate.

packages.summary: Nonnegative integer step/linear progression tables and CLI preview
packages.notes: Author strictly increasing nonnegative x and nonnegative y. Endpoints clamp; linear rounding is toward the left value, including descending segments. Unsafe intermediate products return failure. Use aiverse_app_tools curve to preview exact runtime results; use engine/meta progression owners for built-in experience/rewards.

packages.summary: Bounded observation memory, expiration and threat selection
packages.notes: Feed only visibility-authorized observations; never enumerate hidden enemies into memory. Keep known positions after lost sight until tick TTL expires. Highest threat ties by smaller entity ID; capacity evicts oldest, then smaller ID, and rejects older incoming observations. Use stable packed IDs and clear destroyed targets only when knowledge permits. Persist via Persistence.h.

packages.summary: Bounded structured decision facts using existing reason codes
packages.notes: Collect facts from the actual authoritative calculation, including localization key/subject/required/actual/reason. explain keeps the first failure even when fact output is truncated. Do not infer damage/modifier explanations from guessed formulas. Send display-only reports to UI/debug consumers; keep diagnostics out of state hashes unless they drive behavior.

packages.summary: RTS bot profiles and transactional checkpoints over the existing RtsAI
packages.notes: Use existing RtsAI for economy, build/research, combat, garrisons and terrain/planet play. Host calls update before sim.step. rules.ai may override profiles. Preserve the legacy knowledge policy; do not claim fog-fairness. Save bot state with simulation; exact player/seed/settings must match.

packages.summary: Command-driven FPS bots with perception, reaction, aiming, reload, retreat, zone and patrol
packages.notes: Run on one authoritative host with map bot:false for owned slots. Use fpsCommand then sim.submit; never mutate actors. Persist FpsState with the simulation. Supply generated navmesh or authored waypoint graph; no bomb, loot or vehicle mechanics are implied.

packages.summary: Automatic deterministic layered AABB navigation mesh with clearance, erosion and bounded routing
packages.notes: Build immutable regional polygon meshes from current collision and motor dimensions. Rebuild on geometry changes. Bound cell/polygon/candidate/search budgets. No triangle/slope importer or cross-region streaming links. Use navPath/navStep, real motor tests and aiverse_navmesh exporter.

packages.summary: Actual RTS/FPS bot matches, decision counters and restoration regression tests
packages.notes: Build aiverse_bot_match and root library bot/navmesh tests. Example FPS navmesh bounds target arena; author region bounds for other maps. A timeout is not a win, and bot difficulty presets are not an Elo claim.

packages.summary: Fixed character movement policy with ground/air acceleration, jump buffer and coyote time
packages.notes: Read docs/genre-packages.md for exact coverage and authority boundaries. Policies do not automatically replace existing engine movement/combat/victory or wire presentation. Persist versioned state and bind immutable definitions. Use actual native/host owners for commands, collision and damage.

packages.notes: Read docs/genre-packages.md for exact coverage and authority boundaries. Policies do not automatically replace existing engine movement/combat/victory or wire presentation. Persist versioned state and bind immutable definitions. Use actual native/host owners for commands, collision and damage.

Persist versioned state and bind immutable definitions. Use actual native/host owners for commands, collision and damage.

packages.summary: Initiative, AP and nested reaction scheduling
packages.notes: Bounded runtime implementation; see docs/strategy-libraries.md for limits. Audit areas T1 are only partially addressed. Persist through strategy/Persistence.h in NativeState. Do not duplicate built-in owners.

packages.summary: Card zones, priority stack and private views
packages.notes: Bounded runtime implementation; see docs/strategy-libraries.md for limits. Audit areas K1,K2 are only partially addressed. Persist through strategy/Persistence.h in NativeState. Do not duplicate built-in owners.

packages.summary: Sokoban moves, undo/redo and bounded solver
packages.notes: Bounded runtime implementation; see docs/strategy-libraries.md for limits. Audit areas Q1,Q2 are only partially addressed. Persist through strategy/Persistence.h in NativeState. Do not duplicate built-in owners.

packages.notes: Bounded runtime implementation; see docs/strategy-libraries.md for limits. Audit areas I2 are only partially addressed. Persist through strategy/Persistence.h in NativeState. Do not duplicate built-in owners.

packages.notes: Bounded runtime implementation; see docs/strategy-libraries.md for limits. Audit areas I1 are only partially addressed. Persist through strategy/Persistence.h in NativeState. Do not duplicate built-in owners.

packages.notes: Bounded runtime implementation; see docs/strategy-libraries.md for limits. Audit areas C2 are only partially addressed. Persist through strategy/Persistence.h in NativeState. Do not duplicate built-in owners.

packages.notes: Audit P3: runtime and native integration; physical/UI/audio host integration remains. See docs/strategy-libraries.md.

packages.summary: Integer tempo maps and frame-independent tap/hold judgement
packages.notes: Audit Q5: runtime and native integration; physical/UI/audio host integration remains. See docs/strategy-libraries.md.

packages.summary: Connected seeded runs, encounter budgets and persistent reward lifecycle
packages.notes: D1/K3 runtime subset. Existing inventory remains authoritative; commit grant and run state atomically. Geometry, adaptive director, relic effects and route UI remain host work.

packages.summary: Bounded deterministic integer VM for programming puzzles
packages.notes: Q2 programming-puzzle runtime. Does not replace Lua or authorize host inputs/rewards. Instruction budget, IO waits, faults and full state are explicit.

packages.summary: Host-only Conn admission with audience-bound identity, expiry and revocation
packages.notes: Trusted token verification and secure transport remain host responsibilities. Never use sockets/credentials in simulation callbacks. Native OBJECT modules use aiverse_native_use_session.
